name: canonify-domain-modelling
description: The four obligations every Canonify domain model must meet, each stated as a rule with a worked before/after: reuse the canonical object instead of retyping its name into text columns (C1-shadow-entity), declare the upward link over every FK column, check the platform catalog before modelling a capability it already ships, and model time and money as effective-dated append-only rows with snapshotted settlements and integer minor units (C10-float-money). The other skills teach the mechanics; this one states what is obligatory. Read after the base `canonify` skill and before your first migration.

resources.title: Pricing, end to end
resources.description: Obligation 4 as one continuous build: temporal (effective-dated) list-price and customer-override ObjectTypes, the generated append-only set verb, resolution on the order's own date with $as_of, a settlement action that snapshots the resolved amount plus its back-reference, and the draft/sealed billing report with forward-only adjustment lines.
